description: Dull olive, pale flat eyes, a gape wider than the skull carrying it. One bite. Rarely two.
lore: [[lore/the_chronicle|The Chronicle]] files it beside [[monsters/lava_salamander|the burning one]] because at forty paces they share a silhouette, and there the resemblance ends. Nothing about this animal is lit. It is lichen-olive going grey, the eyes flat, pale and wrong, and the head is mostly jaw — hinged so far back that the gape opens wider than the skull carrying it. It gives no warning at all. One bite, and generally that is the encounter.

What it hunts is the hard things. Bone first — it will spend a night on one marrow bone and leave it knobbed and stained in the open, which is how you know one is working an area — then stone, and gold whenever it finds any, though no one has ever opened one and found gold inside. It works ground nearer the cave than anything else that still has an inside. [[characters/8c41be1e|Hearn]] will guide a cracker as far as the chewed bones and no farther; he waits there facing the mountain, and he does not sit down.

The paws it sheds are never a matching pair: what grows back after a loss comes back approximate, and the next one approximate from the approximation. The hard piece in the jaw is [[items/gold_seamed_teal_soulstone|sea-green, mended through with gold]]; what the mend means is an argument for the people who trade it. The animal goes on taking what refuses to go, and has never once looked like it wondered why.
